"""Independent TF BLIP caption and question graphs using synthetic weights only."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from transformers import BlipConfig,BlipTextConfig,BlipVisionConfig,TFBlipForConditionalGeneration,TFBlipForQuestionAnswering

OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for index,cls in enumerate([TFBlipForConditionalGeneration,TFBlipForQuestionAnswering]):
    kind='caption' if index==0 else 'vqa'
    path=OUT/kind;path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    text=BlipTextConfig(hidden_size=32,intermediate_size=64,num_hidden_layers=2,num_attention_heads=4,
        vocab_size=32,max_position_embeddings=64,bos_token_id=30,sep_token_id=3,eos_token_id=2,pad_token_id=0,
        hidden_dropout_prob=0.0,attention_probs_dropout_prob=0.0)
    vision=BlipVisionConfig(hidden_size=32,intermediate_size=64,num_hidden_layers=2,num_attention_heads=4,image_size=16,patch_size=4,num_channels=3)
    config=BlipConfig(text_config=text.to_dict(),vision_config=vision.to_dict(),projection_dim=16)
    model=cls(config)
    pixels=np.linspace(-1,1,768,dtype=np.float32).reshape(1,3,16,16)
    ids=np.array([[30,7,8,3]],np.int32);mask=np.ones_like(ids)
    inputs={'pixel_values':tf.constant(pixels),'input_ids':tf.constant(ids),'attention_mask':tf.constant(mask)}
    if kind=='vqa':inputs['decoder_input_ids']=tf.constant(ids)
    model(**inputs,training=False)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(6140+index)
    for w in model.weights:
        v=rng.normal(0,0.03,w.shape).astype(np.float32)
        if w.name.endswith('gamma:0'):v+=1
        # A stable ordinary output token keeps end-to-end decode meaningful.
        if w.name.endswith('/predictions/bias:0'):v[7]=1
        w.assign(v)
    images=model.vision_model(tf.constant(pixels),training=False).last_hidden_state
    hidden=images
    if kind=='vqa':
        hidden=model.text_encoder(input_ids=tf.constant(ids),attention_mask=tf.constant(mask),
            encoder_hidden_states=images,encoder_attention_mask=tf.ones(images.shape[:2],tf.int32),training=False).last_hidden_state
    logits=model.text_decoder(input_ids=tf.constant(ids),attention_mask=tf.constant(mask),
        encoder_hidden_states=hidden,encoder_attention_mask=tf.ones(hidden.shape[:2],tf.int32),training=False).logits
    model.save_pretrained(path,safe_serialization=False)
    np.savez(path/'reference.npz',pixel_values=pixels,input_ids=ids,attention_mask=mask,vision=images.numpy(),
        encoder=hidden.numpy(),logits=logits.numpy())
    (path/'weights.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'name':w.name,'shape':list(w.shape)} for w in model.weights],indent=2)+'\n')
    print(kind,len(model.weights),flush=True)
